summary: BrasilAgro (NYSE: LND; B3: AGRO3) disclosed a Material Fact on September 29, 2026, covering the sale of 2,592.97 hectares, including 1,752.66 arable hectares, of Rio do Meio Farm in Correntina, Bahia, plus a lease of 383.44 arable hectares with a purchase option through March 2028. Pricing is 425 soybean bags per arable hectare: R$96.4 million nominal, R$78.8 million present value, roughly 2.9x the R$27.3 million book value, with 26.2% BRL and 20.9% USD expected IRR. BrasilAgro already received the first installment of 181,568.50 soybean bags (about R$21.1 million, 24% of contract volume); the remaining 563,312 bags are payable in four annual installments. The company expects a pre-tax gain of R$51.5 million in fiscal 1Q27. The lease runs to June 2030, with the option exercisable until March 2028 on the same per-hectare basis, covering acreage excluded from the announced sale. No board recommendation or advisor is named in the excerpt. Watch soybean-bag price exposure and counterparty performance risk on the four-year receivable; any option exercise requires separate disclosure.
